hero.title: Together with Christ
hero.description: The National Association of African Catholics in the United States (NAACUS) brings together individuals, families, clergy, religious, and communities to grow in faith, celebrate our rich cultural heritage, develop leaders, and serve the Church and society.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: NAACUS exists to unite African Catholics across the United States through faith formation, leadership development, cultural celebration, evangelization, and service to the Church and society.

whyJoin.title: Why Join NAACUS
whyJoin.description: Become part of a vibrant national community of African Catholics dedicated to growing in faith, supporting one another, and serving the Church.

resources.title: Resources & Links
resources.description: Access educational materials, prayer resources, and links to support your spiritual journey and family life.

leadership.title: Leadership Development
leadership.description: Develop your gifts through leadership training, mentorship programs, and opportunities to serve.

community.title: Vibrant Community
community.description: Connect with African Catholic families and individuals who share your faith and heritage.

network.title: National Network
network.description: Build relationships with African Catholic communities across the United States and strengthen the Church.

spiritual.title: Spiritual Growth
spiritual.description: Deepen your faith through Bible studies, prayer groups, and opportunities to serve in various ministries.

memberBenefits.subtitle: Join a thriving community of African Catholics united in faith, culture, and service across the United States.
memberBenefits.title: Become a Member of NAACUS

events.title: Exclusive Events
events.description: Access to national conferences, workshops, cultural celebrations, and spiritual retreats throughout the year.

women.description: Empowering women through retreats, workshops, and fellowship activities.

youth.title: Youth Ministry
youth.description: Nurturing young Catholics through faith formation, activities, and leadership development.

youngAdults.title: Young Adults Ministry
youngAdults.description: Supporting young adults in their spiritual journey and community life.

men.title: Men's Ministry
men.description: Building brotherhood and strengthening faith among African Catholic men.
